creator: griffybit
statement: Ultimate catching guide is subjective and aimed at the 99 percent of players; goal is higher catching efficiency for late-game bugs and W4 AFK gains.

creator: griffybit
statement: Catching is one of the hardest skills to get high efficiency and bugs per hour on.

creator: griffybit
statement: Guide skips stasis and the Maestro claw of efficiency skill to show good prints are possible without them.

creator: griffybit
statement: Catching is best done with Bubonic Conjuror (B-man); third talent tab has all the major catching talents.

creator: griffybit
statement: In tab 1 prioritize Elusive Efficiency (efficiency percent) and Quickness Boost (base agility, the primary catching stat).

creator: griffybit
statement: In tab 2 take Focus Soul (catching XP gain) and Sanic Speed (base agility); spare points can go to smithing talents.

creator: griffybit
statement: Telekinetic Logs gives catching efficiency based on oak logs in storage scaling by powers of 10 (10; 100; 1000...) so stockpile oak logs.

creator: griffybit
statement: Most points go in tab 3; Telekinetic Logs is a key talent.

creator: griffybit
statement: Getting a plethora of oak logs is very beneficial to catching efficiency.

creator: griffybit
statement: Briar Patch increases the agility stat to give more efficiency per point of agility.

creator: griffybit
statement: Sunset on the Hives is the only catching AFK gains talent; other classes get AFK gains from tab 1.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bug Enthusiast is a decent next choice but he suggests AGI again as it raises tab 1 agility talent which synergizes with Briar.

creator: griffybit
statement: Leftover tab 3 points can go into Schwifty Statues which boosts the catching statue All Reliable.

creator: griffybit
statement: Star talents: Will of the Eldest (+1 all stat per max character level), Tick Tock (AFK gains), Toilet Paper Postage (stamp efficiency), Super Source (base efficiency), Action Frenzy (skilling speed).

creator: griffybit
statement: Best level for Tick Tock is 30 because of diminishing returns after 30.

creator: griffybit
statement: Super Source and Action Frenzy star talents are obtained from the party dungeon Flarbo shop.

creator: griffybit
statement: Catching cards: Chaotic Troll (skill efficiency); Amarok (skill AFK gains); Berry (catching speed); Fly (catching AFK gains); Mosquisnow (efficiency); Fruit Flies (AFK gains); Butterfly (efficiency); Bunny (skill AFK gains).

creator: griffybit
statement: Some of the recommended cards are World 4 cards so they are something to work towards.

creator: griffybit
statement: Until you have the cards use Chaotic Eclipse? and Sentient Cereal for skill XP; Carmen? Bloke and Mafioso for base agility as fillers.

creator: griffybit
statement: Use the Easy Resources card set for extra skill efficiency percentage.

creator: griffybit
statement: Hydron tab (if owned) lets you equip up to three star signs; if not Kronos is fine.

creator: griffybit
statement: With Hydron use Cosmos Major? (4% skill AFK gains), OG Skiller (skill AFK gains) and Shoe Fly (efficiency and multi-bug chance); prowess explained later.

creator: griffybit
statement: Without Hydron use OG Skiller and Shoe Fly as go-to star signs.

creator: griffybit
statement: Gear: two Rex rings for skill efficiency eventually upgraded to serrated Rex rings; Bandido pantaloons from craft tab; Barrel leathering from Anvil tab 1; Bandido boots from Anvil tab 2.

creator: griffybit
statement: Also equip the highest net you have.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bandido boots (Anvil tab 2) are upgraded when you reach Anvil tab 4.

creator: griffybit
statement: Optional achievements: Golden Fly (5% catching efficiency) and Fruit Salad (5% catching speed) for all characters.

creator: griffybit
statement: Thread and Needle is okay but gives XP percent rather than efficiency or AFK gains.

creator: griffybit
statement: Trophy options: Blunder Hill (W1 completion trophy; base agility and 3% AFK gains) is easier; Critter Baron gives 5% agility.

creator: griffybit
statement: Personally prefers the Blunder Hill trophy over Critter Baron.

creator: griffybit
statement: Big post office item is Bug Hunting Supplies: gives catching efficiency percent, prowess effect percent and catching AFK gain percent.

creator: griffybit
statement: Prowess reduces the efficiency needed for 100% catch on a bug set (e.g. 300K efficiency need minus 30%).

creator: griffybit
statement: Invest about 400 boxes into Bug Hunting Supplies; diminishing returns after 200 but still worth it.

creator: griffybit
statement: With spare boxes go Utilitarian Capsule; watch his post office guide before deciding.

creator: griffybit
statement: Use a set of gold and silver obols for catching; get via gem shop or cheaper via alchemy from Grand Obols and Decent Obols.

creator: griffybit
statement: He suggests the cheap route because Damn Obols are expensive.

creator: griffybit
statement: Silver obols are circle and gold obols are square so mix both to maximize catch power.

creator: griffybit
statement: Don't upgrade to platinum: too expensive, catching obols are hard to come by, and hexagon obols block Cheor or Eont taking its place.

creator: griffybit
statement: Alchemy gives most of the absurd damage and efficiency; it's still the true endgame.

creator: griffybit
statement: Sonic Tools (green cauldron bubble 6) gives skilling power for catching nets and is very strong.

creator: griffybit
statement: Swift Steppin (bubble 1) gives base agility; you can never have enough.

creator: griffybit
statement: Archer or Bust (bubble 2) gives a time bonus on all green passive bonuses and stacks hard late game with Sonic Tools.

creator: griffybit
statement: Prima Green (bubble 14) gives a time bonus specifically to bubble 6 Sonic Tools; big late-game scaling.

creator: griffybit
statement: Time bonuses on time bonuses add together first and then multiply; they don't multiply twice.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fly in Mind (bubble 15) gives catching AFK gain percent.

creator: griffybit
statement: Bug Square gives multi-bug catching chance and raises the cap to 300% instead of 100%; must be actively equipped.

creator: griffybit
statement: Catch Net stamp (base catching efficiency) scales off the star talent Toilet Paper Postage and efficiency percent.

creator: griffybit
statement: Buzz stamp gives more multi-bug chance; capacity and XP stamps are optional.

creator: griffybit
statement: Statue of choice is All Reliable which gives catching power; can be obtained mostly from fishing.

creator: griffybit
statement: When farming statues run drop rate gear because it affects statue drops while skilling; Swifty Statues scales off that skill.

creator: griffybit
statement: Use food only for 3D prints; Mistle berries come from the gift event and butter toast (from crafting) gives catching speed.

creator: griffybit
statement: Fruit flies are a basic threshold and stopping point for most people in catching.

creator: griffybit
statement: Prayers: Skill Dimwit (72% skill efficiency gain) and Royal Sampler (15% 3D printer size); both remove XP gain.

creator: griffybit
statement: Don't expect to level fast using these two prayers because both remove XP gain.

creator: griffybit
statement: His talents are already maxed so there are slight variations versus a typical player.

creator: griffybit
statement: His extras: Snoozy Cap 10% AFK gains, Angel Wings 11% AFK gains, candy 6% and Blunder Hero 3%; you'd be about 21% lower without the cap and wings.

creator: griffybit
statement: On fruit flies: 4753 bugs per hour, 140% AFK gain rate, nearly 1 million max efficiency, 3D print 331 which is high for this level.

creator: griffybit
statement: On flies his 3D print is printing 15K per hour showing how juiced the print is.

creator: griffybit
statement: Asks viewers to comment if method works and mentions a new subreddit for the community.
